title: Pipeline stages: build, change set, approve, deploy, verify
description: After a green main, an Actions job starts the pipeline for that exact commit, skipping stale results as Apricity's scripts/deploy-amplify.sh does (including a release commit landing after CI). Stages: source at that commit; CodeBuild runs scripts/dev/build_lab_package.sh and confirms cli_login is in the zip; upload by content hash with no overwrite; create the change set keeping previous parameters; read it and either continue or wait at the native approval action, per the approval task; execute; compare CodeSha256; probe the API without credentials (POST /machine/bindings/anth-us/operations on the API Gateway endpoint expects 403; lab.cyclotron.anth.us is Amplify); check logs and the dead-letter queue; roll back to the previous package key on failure. Executions are serialized. No tests run in AWS. A failure must fail the Actions run visibly.
